verdict.rationale: Anytype documents Queries that assemble results instantly from criteria you define, which gives filter-style retrieval. Its offline-first design means the app always works without an internet connection, and the local API, which also runs offline, supports searching Objects. However, no evidence describes in-app full-text search across note content, or filtering specifically by tags, properties, or paths. missing for 10: documented full-text search of note bodies, explicit tag/property/path filter docs, confirmation that search itself works offline, independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed and quality.
